description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'GatewayJwtIssuerNotSupportedException' which extends 'DittoRuntimeException'. It signifies that a JWT issued by an unsupported issuer was encountered, typically during token validation in a security/authentication context. The class includes builder patterns for constructing instances with specific details and methods for creating exceptions from messages or JSON objects.
